decision.minimum_boundary: Two novel modules A/B, one non-contribution thin integration shell/config owner, and a q32/640-byte correction of M384 with refreshed assertions and receipts.
decision.preferred_prefix_implementation: Per-row pass0 followed immediately by conditional pass1 using one explicitly counted register scratch; preserve row order and add no descriptor scratch traffic.
decision.why_no_full_641m_vcs: M401 and independent M402 already replay every frozen phase in the cycle simulator. VCS must prove local arithmetic, protocol, task conservation, service width and representative real-value integration; it cannot turn simulator cycles into RTL-measured speedup by merely running the same aggregate duration.

accepted_upstream_candidate_not_new_spee.scope: H67 ep35 no-running, ten zurich_city_09_a samples, four bottleneck Conv3x3 modules
accepted_upstream_candidate_not_new_spee.admission: Independent trace-cycle replay accepted only; no RTL-measured, system, energy, PPA or headline speedup.

mandatory_noncontribution_support: A thin config/integration shell that accepts one ordered 96-byte config command as three 32-byte beats and gives patterns and bitmap a single owner.
A revised M384 control/address cut with 640-byte PWP stride, new slot0 bases/bounds and unchanged D8/L8 descriptor protocol.
A VCS integration harness that connects B output to revised M384 and models the single SHARED96 backend acceptance contract without implementing a full-system scheduler.
external_named_boundaries: Two 3000x48-bit descriptor SRAM banks remain external and unchanged in capacity.
The two 32-KiB PWP/weight slots remain external; no macro area or timing is inferred.
The 32-byte/cycle cmd32 DMA engine and SHARED96 accumulator/backend remain cycle-model boundaries.
minimum_standalone_boundary.publication_contribution_rule: A and B may be presented as one composed contribution: exact width-elastic PWP issue plus lossless nested-prefix early termination. The thin shell and M384 patch are enabling integration, not separate innovations.

storage_format.narrow_rule: Every signed12 lane is in inclusive [-128,127].

single_input_port.high_logical_bytes_64_through_95: Invalid on the physical record and zeroized by the adapter; they are not stored or charged as traffic.
single_input_port.beat_metadata: kind, phase/tag, tile, descriptor identity, center_id and global_output_block_id must be stable and identical across a wide pair.

lane_packing.physical_padding: high bytes 48 through 63 must all be zero

issue_semantics.wide_high_contribution: sign_extend_int4(high_nibble) shifted left by eight in signed12
issue_semantics.done_rule: done is asserted only with the accepted final contribution; no saturation, rounding, activation or other nonlinear operation may occur between the two wide contributions.

atomic_wide_protocol.rule: Buffer the low beat. For a wide block, accept and validate the matching high beat and all 16 physical padding bytes before any low or high contribution becomes externally accepted.
atomic_wide_protocol.malformed_high: Set sticky protocol_error and suppress both contributions and done for that block; no partial accumulator update is permitted.
atomic_wide_protocol.ready_valid: All payload, metadata and contribution outputs hold stable under backpressure. No next block may overwrite a buffered or partially emitted wide transaction.
atomic_wide_protocol.no_stall_service_goal: After named pipeline fill, accepted contributions are contiguous whenever source beats and downstream ready are available; narrow consumes one and wide consumes two contribution cycles with no width-transition bubble.

module_a_exact_elastic_pwp_issue_adapter.metadata_trust_boundary: The hardware cannot infer a semantically false narrow bit from low8 alone. The 256-bit bitmap is checkpoint/catalog-derived trusted configuration protected by offline exhaustive codec audit and configuration integrity; a flipped bitmap must make the reference miter fail but need not be locally detectable without reading the sidecar.

config.reload_rule: Ordered 0/1/2 only while idle; wrong index, early/late commit, phase mutation or reload while busy is a sticky fail-closed protocol error.
config.exports: The 512 pattern bits are the sole center-table owner and the 256 bitmap bits feed module A lookup; any duplicated copy must be separately counted and equality-checked.

task_server.tie_break: Minimum Hamming distance, then lowest global center ID.
task_server.pass0: Every source row executes centers 0 through 15.
task_server.pass1_condition: Execute centers 16 through 31 if and only if popcount16(original)>=2 and registered pass0 best_distance>0.
task_server.legal_early_stop: Only a complete registered pass0 with best_distance==0 on a popcount>=2 row; a positive distance or mid-task stop is forbidden.
task_server.dependency_timing: Pass0 accepted in task cycle t must produce its registered decision at the normal boundary so conditional pass1, or the next row pass0, can be accepted in task cycle t+1 with no idle task cycle under ready-high conditions.
task_server.source_order: Rows leave in original order. Eligible pass1 is immediately adjacent to its pass0 in the preferred design.

preferred_single_row_register_scratch.reason: A row is held across its optional second task, so M401's 3000+unresolved+2 task recurrence is preserved without an external scratch pass, address holes, random patch writes or reordered output.
preferred_single_row_register_scratch.mandatory_area_accounting: Count scratch valid/state, any phase tag/bank, the full registered pass0 winner and every output/skid bit in DC hierarchy reports.

module_b_q32_serial16_zero_stop_controll.popcount_less_than_two_semantics: Zero and popcount-one rows never issue pass1 and never use PWP. Their center metadata may be the deterministic pass0 winner because it is nonarchitectural for fallback, but the value and distance must remain self-consistent and stable; comparisons must not pretend a free q32 global search occurred.

incompatibilities: M321 ties by center value, not global center ID.
M321 implements tau/snapped semantics, not q32 exact-zero pass control.
M321 is a two-stage result pipeline and does not prove the one-task dependency boundary required by the preferred single-row controller.

optional_descriptor_bank_scratch_not_sel.tie_rule: A pass1 equality keeps the pass0 winner because every pass0 global ID is below every pass1 global ID.
optional_descriptor_bank_scratch_not_sel.why_not_selected: It adds compact unresolved writes, reads and random final-bank patch writes, complicates in-order proof and energy, and repurposes the second descriptor bank so it cannot simultaneously be described as phase ping-pong.
optional_descriptor_bank_scratch_not_sel.port_hazard: A one-read/write scratch bank cannot be written and prefetched in the same pass0 cycle. Hiding L8 requires a proved 1R1W/dual-port macro or an explicitly counted tail buffer/schedule; cross-phase-overlap=false does not create a memory port.
gates_if_implemented: Name the descriptor macro port model and prove no same-bank conflict.
Add unresolved scratch W/R and final random patch W counts to cycle and energy ledgers.
Prove allocated final addresses contain no holes at seal and row order is exact.
Measure any pass-boundary L8/startup gap and recompute the 1.15 gate.
Stop calling the two banks phase ping-pong unless that use remains physically possible.

mandatory_m384_q32_layout_patch.required_regression: Update RTL, SVA and TB together; exhaust every legal start/length pair with start+length<=32, both tiles, all-zero/full/disjoint bitmaps, backpressure and all existing protocol attacks. Then rerun M384 VCS, DC, Formality and PrimeTime because the old receipts bind the old SHA and layout.

module_a_exact_arithmetic: Replay all 442,368 M401/M402 static PWP blocks and 42,467,328 lanes; require zero narrow/wide reconstruction mismatch, zero wrong width decision and zero nonzero physical padding.
Cover signed boundaries -2048, -129, -128, -1, 0, 127, 128, 255 and 2047; mixed narrow/wide lanes; every operator, tile and global output block.
Require one accepted contribution for every narrow block and two for every wide block, exact done placement and no ready-high width-transition bubble after named fill.
module_b_reference_miter: Cover zero, popcount-one, eligible q16 exact hit, eligible unresolved, q32-only exact hit, positive no-exact, pass0/pass1 ties and strict equality fallback.
Use frozen real values from all 1,728 operator/partition configurations where each class exists, plus deterministic random and at least one exhaustive 65,536-source-pattern sweep per operator.
Require pass0 tasks=source rows, pass1 tasks=eligible rows minus eligible q16 exact hits, and output order/conservation exact.
integration: Route the ordered three-beat config once, connect B to revised M384, and exercise A with the block-local bitmap lookup and one SHARED96 contribution sink.

Under source-ready/output-ready/SRAM-ready high, every task and contribution gap must equal a named dependency, L8 fill or fixed tail already present in the cycle contract; any additional gap is a measured blocking component.
Randomize config, descriptor response, PWP source and contribution backpressure independently; require stable payload, no loss, duplication, reorder or credit overflow.
sva_negative_controls: High beat without a pending wide low, low/low or high/high ordering, tag/tile/center/block mismatch and narrow-plus-high injection.
Nonzero one of the 16 physical high-sidecar padding bytes; nibble-order swap; wrong keep/valid-byte count; reset or config reload mid-wide.
Flip a true narrow bitmap bit on a wide block and require the external exact reference miter to fail.
Stop on positive distance, issue pass1 after q16 distance zero, skip pass1 after eligible positive distance, credit zero/pop1 as early-hit and change lower-ID tie handling.
Wrong config beat order/commit, mutation while active, descriptor FIFO credit overflow, illegal SRAM response identity and stale 576-byte address/run expectation.
what_vcs_can_prove: RTL arithmetic and protocol exactness for tested/exhaustive module populations.
One/two accepted contribution service, one-cycle registered prefix dependency and absence of internal ready-high bubbles.
Ready/valid conservation and fail-closed behavior under directed/random stalls.
what_vcs_cannot_prove: External SRAM/DMA always supplies ready, average blocking is below 0.0651098, or tile1 DMA is physically hidden.
Full-network/system speedup, physical memory timing, energy or paper PPA.

order: Freeze exact RTL/SVA/TB/filelist/SDC/library hashes and pass VCS first.
Run 3.000 ns logic-only DC for A, B, revised M384 and the integrated selected slice; report each hierarchy and the unduplicated total.
Run RTL-to-mapped-netlist Formality for each leaf and the integrated top using its exact SVF/netlist; zero failing, aborted, unmatched and unverified functional points.
Run PrimeTime prelayout STA on the integrated mapped netlist and propagated mapped SDC after Formality; setup and hold must both meet with no unexplained untested functional endpoint.
Only later attach macro timing, SAIF/PTPX and post-route evidence; none is implied by selected-RTL promotion.

frequency_gate.rule: Use the same 3 ns clock for baseline and candidate. A slower candidate cannot retain 1.15 throughput merely from cycle ratio; it must be time-normalized and re-admitted.

logic_only_area_gate.derivation: Old M384 7,588.223873 + 1.5x old incompatible 512-bit M133 10,853.766052 + 2x old incompatible M321 1,942.541962 = 27,753.956875 um2, leaving about 8.09% integration headroom.
required_reporting: A including low/high atomic buffers, metadata, zeroization and output skid
B including 768 config bits, single-row scratch, winner tree and output skid
thin shell and integrated unduplicated total
combinational/sequential cells, logic levels, macros and all black boxes
logic_only_area_gate.boundary: This is a pre-macro selected-slice guardrail, not full accelerator area or paper PPA. The M133/M321/M384 values are planning references only and their admission does not transfer.

promotion_gates.upstream: M401 and independent M402 inner/outer seals verify and docs/359 remains unchanged.
promotion_gates.functional: All A/B/revised-M384 VCS and SVA gates pass with zero exactness, ordering, protocol, conservation or address mismatch.
promotion_gates.cycle: Every new fixed fill/drain or measured internal blocking cycle is inserted into the M402 per-phase recurrence; the updated candidate remains <=645,346,422 cycles for any retained 1.15 cycle claim.
promotion_gates.blocking: Ready-high internal blocking is zero after named pipeline fill. External backpressure is not assumed away in an RTL-measured claim; 0.25 cycle/descriptor is an explicit failing sensitivity.
promotion_gates.frequency: A, B, revised M384 and integrated slice all meet common 3.000 ns in DC and PrimeTime.
promotion_gates.area: Integrated logic-only selected-slice area is <=30,000 um2 with every buffer/config/scratch bit counted and no unnamed macro.
promotion_gates.equivalence: All exact-SHA Formality jobs pass after DC.
promotion_gates.promotion_result: Passing these gates admits standalone selected RTL and logic-only area/timing only; it does not convert M402 into RTL-measured/system/paper performance.

findings.title: M384 implements the wrong PWP layout for the selected candidate
findings.detail: RTL, SVA and TB bind tile0 PWP base 6208 and stride/run 576. M401/M402 require config96, weight@96, PWP@6240, stride/run640 and new 26720/59392 bounds. Old VCS/DC/FM/PT receipts cannot be reused after this SHA-visible change.

findings.title: Wide service must be atomic before an irreversible accumulator update
findings.detail: If low8 is emitted before the high sidecar/tag/padding is validated, a later protocol error cannot undo the low contribution. The selected adapter must buffer low and validate high before committing either contribution, then prove one/two-beat service and no width-transition bubble.

findings.title: The preferred one-row scratch depends on a true one-task result boundary
findings.detail: M401 counts pass0 and conditional pass1 as adjacent tasks. A pass0 result must be registered soon enough to issue pass1 next cycle. M321's two-stage topology does not prove this dependency. If 3 ns requires deeper latency, the implementation needs explicitly counted multi-context/ROB state or an updated cycle recurrence.

findings.title: The selected point has almost no unmodeled blocking or frequency budget
findings.detail: Only 3,555,718 integer cycles, 0.0651097608 cycle per replayed descriptor under the strict integer ceiling, and 0.551% matched-frequency loss separate 1.15637 from the 1.15 gate. Module VCS cannot prove external ready or DMA overlap; every fixed or measured internal bubble must be named and replayed.

findings.title: Two novel modules still require non-novel integration evidence
findings.detail: A and B are sufficient contribution boundaries only with a thin config owner, revised M384 and an integration harness. Omitting these would leave config duplication, address generation and descriptor/backend handoff unverified.

findings.title: The narrow bitmap is trusted semantic metadata
findings.detail: A low8 beat alone cannot reveal that a declared narrow lane needed non-sign-extension high bits. Exhaustive offline codec construction and configuration integrity are part of the exactness proof; local hardware catches malformed protocol, not an adversarial but well-formed false bitmap.

findings.title: M321 is a structure prior, not q32 controller evidence
findings.detail: Its old area/timing is useful for planning, but center-value ties, tau semantics and two-stage dependency latency differ. New q32 RTL needs fresh reference miter, VCS, DC, Formality and PrimeTime.

findings.title: Descriptor-bank scratch is possible but inferior for q32
findings.detail: A 48-bit positive-unresolved record can be packed exactly, but it adds SRAM traffic, random final writes, ordering proof and a port/L8 hazard. The one-row register scratch matches the same task count without those costs.

findings.title: A full 641M-cycle VCS run would not prove physical performance
findings.detail: Module/exhaustive value VCS plus independently sealed full cycle replay is the appropriate boundary. Replaying aggregate duration in RTL does not establish SRAM readiness, DMA overlap, energy, routed frequency or a system speedup.

findings.title: Physical memory, power and broader scope remain outside selected RTL
findings.detail: The result still covers four Conv modules and one ten-sample runtime cohort. No PWP/descriptor macro, SAIF/PTPX, post-route timing, cross-sequence stability, full-network Amdahl result or paper PPA is admitted.
